preconditions.description: The number of intersections n is between 1 and 2*10^5, inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 1 and 2*10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each pair of intersections is connected by no more than one road
preconditions.description: Each road connects a unique pair of intersections.

preconditions.expression: No road connects the intersection to itself
preconditions.description: No road connects an intersection to itself.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' indicating that the routes can be created, or 'NO' indicating that it is impossible.

postconditions.expression: If output is 'YES', then three routes are provided
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then the next three lines must contain the descriptions of the three routes, each starting and ending at the same intersection, with no common junctions or roads between the routes.

postconditions.expression: If output is 'YES', then the routes must meet all the requirements specified in the statement
postconditions.description: The routes must start and end at the same intersection, have no common junctions (except for the start and end), and no common roads (irrespective of the driving direction).

invariants.expression: The graph is a simple undirected graph
invariants.description: The graph formed by the intersections and roads is a simple undirected graph, meaning no self-loops and no multiple edges.
The graph is connected, meaning there is a path between any two intersections.
